# MM-P2-L1-RR01-S2 Fastener inspection and torque - Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P2, line P2-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L1-RR01

Scope
- Procedure for inspection and torque verification of structural and rotating fasteners on EQ-P2-L1-RR01. Applies to maintenance technicians and shift leads prior to production start and after major disassembly. Maximum ring outer diameter for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L1-RR01) is 1125 mm. See MM-P2-L1-RR01 for machine specific disassembly diagrams.

Tools
- Calibrated torque wrench suitable for specified torque requirements listed in SOP-P2-L1-02.  
- Inspection mirror, flashlight, thread chaser, non-metallic drift, and torque verification witness tags.  
- Lubricant: CFW-LUB-724.

Procedure
- Visually inspect all exposed fasteners for corrosion, round-over, paint build-up, and evidence of fretting. Refer to SB-1013 for bolt condition grading criteria.  
- Confirm correct fastener type and grade per MM-P2-L1-RR01 assembly drawings. Clean threads with solvent and thread chaser where necessary. Apply CFW-LUB-724 to threads only where SOP-P2-L1-02 permits lubrication.  
- Sequence torque application in controlled pattern consistent with SOP-P2-L1-02. Use calibrated torque wrench and apply torque until tool indicates completion per the tool’s setting. Record final torque call-out in maintenance log and attach witness tag.  
- For fasteners on rotating elements, ensure runout and clamping surfaces are clean and contact fully. Replace any fastener that fails visual or thread integrity checks; reference SB-1013 rejection criteria.

Acceptance criteria
- All fasteners present, properly seated, and free of damage or excessive wear per SB-1013.  
- Fasteners lubricated only with CFW-LUB-724 where required and applied per SOP-P2-L1-02.  
- Torque values and sequence documented in maintenance log and cross-referenced to SOP-P2-L1-02.  
- Machine may be released for operation after verification against MM-P2-L1-RR01 and completion of sign-off block.
